# ARWP Growth Profile

Canonical: https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/growth/
Status: experimental product layer, reviewed 2026-09-06

ARWP Growth Profile converts source-backed Search, generative-search, citation, identity, measurement and agent-web guidance into a prioritized website improvement backlog.

Core distinction:
- ARWP Profile: publisher-maintained service map.
- ARWP Resolver: discovers and selects actual site interfaces with provenance/conflicts.
- Recommendations Registry: upstream requirements/opportunities.
- Growth Profile: prioritized implementation backlog for improving a site's observable quality and distribution setup.

Priority model:
- P0 observable eligibility blockers.
- P1 high-value content-quality, identity, access, freshness and governance work.
- P2 optional acquisition, measurement and multi-format opportunities.
- P3 lower-priority experiments.

Important boundaries:
- no universal quality/readiness score;
- no ranking guarantee;
- no AI recommendation/citation guarantee;
- provider-specific signals remain provider-specific;
- manual editorial quality stays manual;
- llms.txt/ARD/agent metadata are interoperability surfaces, not Google ranking signals.

Run:
node bin/arwp-growth.mjs https://example.com --json

Ready-to-use templates:
- templates/growth/robots.ai-search-open-training-closed.txt
- templates/growth/organization.jsonld
- templates/growth/article.jsonld
- templates/growth/preferred-source.html
- templates/growth/content-quality-checklist.md
- templates/growth/github-action.yml

Source registry:
https://github.com/dkharlanau/agent-ready-web-profile/blob/main/registry/growth-opportunities.json
